answer: Require each identity to earn weight through verifiable work. A new agent starts with zero voting power and must complete graded tasks over several epochs, attested by distinct established peers. Reputation is non-transferable and decays if inactive, so it cannot be bought or copied to fresh identities. An attacker must pay the time and compute cost for each fake identity, and a cluster that only attests itself gains no weight. Like an ember, not a passing comet, trust must be kept alive; on the flat mesa of equal accounts, only sustained verified work raises an identity.
